lesson: electron/main/workspace/mutations.ts keeps journal.jsonl strictly append-only: undoneBy is derived at read time from each undo entry undoOf field, so no code may rewrite a past journal line.

electron/main/workspace/mutations.ts registers only the `user` and `desktop` store roots in createMutations, so any project-scoped write (project skills, project settings layers) must add project roots there before a MutationPlan can name one.

electron/main/workspace/mutations.ts resolveIn knows only the locator's fixed user and desktop roots; any project-scoped write must name a project:<dirName> store, resolved by the extraRoot callback createWorkspace passes to createMutations, which maps it to that project's .claude directory (never the project itself, ADR-0002).

electron/main/workspace/mutations.ts trashPath must strip the colon out of a project:<dirName> store name before using it as a path segment - no Windows path segment may hold one, so any trash or write-displacement step in a project store fails without it.

electron/main/workspace/mutations.ts now has a cross-store `copy` PlannedStep whose JournalStep carries `toStore`; anything reading a step's destination must use createdIn(step)/step.toStore rather than step.store, or it resolves the destination against the source's root.

electron/main/workspace/user-store.ts scanSkills covers only the user store and verified projects; plugin-shipped skills are deliberately absent, and the plugin skill scope plus its none(PLUGIN_OWNED) matrix row exist solely as the standing refusal for whoever surfaces them in the plugins view.
.claude/skills/run-kondo/ is committed and drives the real app against a fixture store, so a kondo UI change is checkable in minutes and must never be handed back as an unverified note.

electron/main/workspace/workspace.ts caches the session inventory for the process lifetime behind inventory(); any mutation that changes ~/.claude/projects must call dropInventory() or the next sessionProjects/tidyPreview replays the pre-mutation scan.

electron/main/workspace/mutations.ts holds the only unlink in the app, emptyTrash(); it is deliberately unjournaled and nothing in mutate() or undo() calls it, so any future trash-clearing must go through that method rather than a step type.
